translated_title: Sculptures of Fidel Castro and Ernesto 'Che' Guevara Will Be Built Again and Placed in Mexico City
original_title: Esculturas de Fidel Castro y Ernesto 'Che' Guevara serán construidas otra vez y colocadas en la CDMX
author: Elba Mónica Bravo
meta_description: The life-size figures, known as Encuentro, sat on a bench in Tabacalera until the Cuauhtémoc mayor removed them last July, a removal officials later deemed illegal.
